operations.title: The principal vertical column is horizontal in the actual reconstructed connection convention
operations.description: For the canonical two-prime weighted packet, the matrices obey dF=A F and dA-A wedge A=0. Retaining the complete normal residue gives d_t R_e-A_t R_e+R_e A_t=0 exactly, so the principal vertical map is a morphism of tangential connections and requires no mixed homotopy at residue level.
